Per the file, note that by default, (per the file) the commission rate for (per the file) block fee revenue is (per the file) 100% and support for other rates is to be added in [SIMD-0123]. Per the file, in order to eliminate (per the file) the overhead of tracking (per the file) the latest commission collector (per the file) address of each vote acct, the commission collector address ought to be fetched from the (per the file) state of the vote acct at the beginning of the previous epoch.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Per the file, validator identity and fee collector accts no longer need to be the same acct. Per the file, this opens up the (per the file) ability to use PDA accts for block revenue collection. Per the file, inflation reward commissions no (per the file) longer need to be collected into a node's vote acct. Per the file, this nodes more flexibility over managing inflation reward income.
